title: Talking about what matters, without an interview
summary: Faith, family and the future, a little at a time.

paragraphs: If you want a life partner, values matter: faith, family, money, where you want to live. You don't have to cover all of it on day one, and you shouldn't wait months either.
Share something about yourself before asking. “My faith is a big part of my week. How about you?” feels like a conversation, not a questionnaire.
sections.heading: Go first

paragraphs: Ask why, not just what. Two people who both “want kids someday” may mean very different things. Curiosity about the reasons tells you more than the answer.
sections.heading: Be curious

paragraphs: Together journeys end each level with a question to talk about. They're an easy, low-pressure way to get to the bigger topics.
sections.heading: Use your journey
